race.comment: BIG TIME CHARLIE (2) is likely to be better over further, but he comes into calculations racing over the mile on resumption. Was plain before the break, but his form prior is hard to knock and if he can return in similar fashion, this is well within his grasp.TIDAL RUSH (1) was no match for the winner but held his own in a BM74 here last time out at this trip. He was big odds there, but this is an easier race and if he can run up to that level again from an inside barrier, he can put his best foot forward. I DOUBT IT (7) draws the inside and can play a leading role. TAKE THE CHANCE (9) is on the quick turnaround today but her recent form stacks right up. Live chance if she handles the back up.
